home.heroSubheading: Empower your commercial team with AI simulators and a virtual coach that delivers immediate, objective and unbiased feedback — at scale.

home.techHeading: Technology solutions to empower your sales team with AI.
home.productsBody: Each module solves a specific link in the chain — from objection handling to coaching feedback. They work even better together.
home.product1Desc: Real feedback. Fast, practical sessions where reps record, refine and master their pitch.
home.product2Desc: Practice real-world scenarios. Handle objections in a safe, AI-driven environment, again and again.
home.product3Desc: Your AI sales coach, on-demand. Personalised guidance built around each rep's strengths and gaps.
home.whyBody: Training sales force with artificial intelligence simulators provides immediate and objective feedback, customizes training scenarios, and allows unlimited practice. It also ensures fair evaluations, makes progress tracking easier, and prepares sales representatives for real-world situations, enhancing their confidence and effectiveness.

home.feature2Body: Every rep is graded against the same rubric. No favourites, no awkwardness.
home.feature3Body: Train teams in EN, ES, and the languages your customers actually speak.
home.feature4Body: Skill curves and trend analytics across your entire commercial org.
home.edgeHeading: Objective & unbiased feedback — at every interaction.
home.edgeBody: Even a 5% lift in messaging accuracy compounds into millions in pipeline. That is what AI-powered training unlocks.
home.testimonialQuote: Thanks to Rolplay, our commercial team significantly improved their results in just a few weeks. Customer experience improved notably.

about.heroBody: RolPlay is a technology firm with more than 20 years of experience developing virtual platforms for training, coaching, and communication. Founded in Mexico in 2002, it has grown by expanding its services and client base.
about.card1Body: What began in 2002 as a Mexican innovation has grown into a North-American operation, with expansion into Toronto, Canada, serving teams across the continent.
about.card2Body: Our solutions support some of the largest companies on the planet — across pharmaceuticals, energy, retail and finance — with measurable training outcomes.
about.missionBody: Boost your sales potential through intelligent training, building teams that inspire trust and achieve meaningful closes.
about.globeBody: From Toronto to Mexico City, our teams partner with leading companies to redefine how sales is taught, practiced and measured.

benefits.heroTitle: Built for the moments that close deals.
benefits.heroBody: Training a sales force with artificial intelligence simulators provides immediate and objective feedback, personalizes training scenarios, and allows unlimited practice.
benefits.coreHeading: Fail a thousand times in private.
benefits.keyMessage: We eliminate the awkwardness and judgment of traditional roleplays between colleagues. We offer a safe and 100% objective environment where your team can fail a thousand times with our AI, ensuring they are flawless when the moment of truth arrives in front of the client.
benefits.pillar1Summary: Fair, objective evaluations — every single time.
benefits.pillar1Body: Traditional roleplays carry the weight of social dynamics and personal preferences. Our AI evaluates every rep against the same rubric, removing favoritism and ensuring training outcomes are based purely on demonstrated skill.
benefits.pillar2Summary: Train teams in the languages your customers actually speak.
benefits.pillar2Body: Whether your reps sell in English, Spanish, or any combination, our simulators preserve the nuance of each language — accents, idioms, and cultural context — so practice mirrors reality.
benefits.pillar3Summary: Skill curves, conversion drivers, and trend analytics — live.
benefits.pillar3Body: Stop waiting for quarterly reviews. Sales leaders see real-time dashboards: who is improving, who is stuck on objections, and where targeted coaching will move the revenue needle fastest.
benefits.boldStatement: Practice the hard parts in private so you don't fail in public.
